bestBets.overview: TEE GALLERIA finally got his maiden out of the way winning here last start. Never runs a bad race and although this a step up and he can go on and win again. MERIMBULA started big odds here last start but he ran into a minor placing. Comes back to 1300m but no reasson he will not be in the mix again. FLASH KERMY comes into this off a maiden win at Katherine. She had been placed here prior and would not leave out of chances while SAXON BEACH is still a maiden but he is never far away and third-up would not leave out of exotics.

raceTips.comment: Two key speed influences in Tee Galleria and Flash Kermy. Both were good last start and both step up in grade. Flash Kermy won dominantly and just needs to hold his form to be competitive again. Tee Galleria beat home Flash Kermy to break his maiden last start and should handle the step up in trip well.

bestBets.overview: BIDEN TIME powered away and won by a space here two starts back then he was beaten when odds-on here last start. Drawn perfectly and he can bounce back in this field. ROMANTIC LOVE was not beaten all that far when favourite two back before battling last outing. Drawn perfectly and looks winning chance. I LOVERAIN was not beaten all that far at Katherine last start. He is a must for exotics while KESSLER comes out of the same Katherine race as I Loverain last start and he can sneak a place.

raceTips.comment: Biden Time drops in class and trip and Todd sticks. Drawn well he should settle in a forward position and be given every chance in the run. Romantic Love can settle further forward from the inside gate after being slow out last start. I Loverain is another who should roll forward and loves racing here. Debating can improve second up and the stable must be respected.

bestBets.overview: IF I WAS YOU started favourite here last start and won with something in hand. Drawn to get the perfect run in behind the speed and he can win again. TIME TO BACA battled on well enough when just out of placings here last start. She is never far away in her races and would not leave out. JUICE BOX chased home well enough when placed at Katherine last start. This no harder and must include again. MR MARRAKECH was beaten less than 2 lengths here last start and that form good enough to sneak into exotics.

raceTips.comment: If I Was You brings the best last start rating to this contest. He has a great turn of foot and the small field suits. He is short enough in the market though. At the price I thought Time To Baca could represent some value. She was racing well earlier this preparation and put in an improved run when stepping back in trip last start.

bestBets.overview: TEARS ARE FLOWING made a good debut when placed in the Territory when placed behind Polarising first-up. Sure to be better from that experience and she can get away with this. ORDER ONLINE battled on solidly when beaten less than a length here last start. He finds similar race and will be in the mix again. SASSY ABBEY is another that finished within a length of winner here last start. She can sneak into a minor spot while PAFITIS won maiden here two starts back before battling last start. He may figure in first four wagers.

raceTips.comment: Market late will be the best guide here. Tears Are Flowing has the best form but resumes and you think Todd would have had the pick of the Clarke runners, so the apprentice booking does raise some questions. The main danger is Order Online was good when settling forward when first up last start. Strips fitter and Todd goes on. Must be respected.

bestBets.overview: WILD BEAU was dominant winning a couple in a row at theis track before a placing in the Palmerston Sprint last start. He gets chance to return to winners stall. ARIZONA ACTIVIST finished too well and got the prize this track/distance last start. Drawn perfectly and would not leave out. SHIRSHOV started favourite here last start but did not finish race off well enough. He is good enough to bounce back in this while RIVKIN comes off a last start win. Back to the 1000m but he has chance to make it two straight.

raceTips.comment: Arizona Activist showed an impressive turn of foot to let down and win last start. He had a fast tempo to suit but was still good enough to do it. He will get back and be charging home late again. Wild Beau is the map horse. He comes here in great form and should find the front and look the winner for a long way.
